title: Hybrid Eco-friendly Coating on Bamboo Fabric through Taguchi Formulations for Flame and Thermal Resistance
review_scope: Complete official 22-page v1 PDF, including later-added version-of-record notice; own characterization, results and conclusion checked; final journal fulltext not reviewed
reason: Nine Taguchi fabric formulations have TG under nitrogen and air, but the source evaluates burning by UL94 vertical testing and microcalorimetry, with no own LOI test or LOI numerical values. The 20% oxygen value in the methods is the MCC gas concentration, not LOI. Final journal cannot be assumed numerically equivalent or given a source-wide exclusion from this preprint review.
